request.text: 北京时间十月十八日下午，上海大师赛男单决赛。达维多维奇·福基纳，对阵霍达尔。一场西班牙球员的冠军争夺。

utterances.display_text: 二十岁的霍达尔，前一天刚淘汰梅德韦杰夫。首盘的底线拉锯，他占了上风。七次超过九拍的长回合，他全部拿下；两个破发点，也都兑现。
utterances.tts_text: 二十岁的霍达尔，前一天刚淘汰梅德韦杰夫。首盘的底线拉锯，他占了上风。七次超过九拍的常回合，他全部拿下；两个破发点，也都兑现。

request.text: 二十岁的霍达尔，前一天刚淘汰梅德韦杰夫。首盘的底线拉锯，他占了上风。七次超过九拍的常回合，他全部拿下；两个破发点，也都兑现。

utterances.display_text: 更难的是，第二盘来到二比二，他又丢了发球局。已经落后一盘，还要再追一个破发。冠军还很远，先要把比赛留住。
utterances.tts_text: 更难的是，第二盘来到二比二，他又丢了发球局。已经落后一盘，还要再追一个破发。冠军还很远，先要把比赛留住。

request.text: 更难的是，第二盘来到二比二，他又丢了发球局。已经落后一盘，还要再追一个破发。冠军还很远，先要把比赛留住。

utterances.display_text: 从底线追到网前，倒地也要把球救回来。这个回破，福基纳靠的是再多打一拍。但追平还不够，随后三个发球局，他又把五个破发点全部救了回来。

utterances.display_text: 双方来到抢七。前十个小分，各自守住发球分，五比五。福基纳终于抢到接发分，随后再拿一分。七比五！第二盘拿下，冠军的争夺，还要继续。

utterances.display_text: 决胜盘，福基纳先破发，可下一局就被回破，双方又回到同一起跑线。好不容易抢来的主动，又被追了回来。要赢，他还得再来一次。

limitations: No actual hearing capability was available; unsupported audio helper is not represented as listening.
Generic CTC model has common independent label errors. Only bounded calibrated position-specific evidence is accepted; failed or weak model checks are retained in history.
Reference controls are genuine synthesized proxy pronunciations; they may change coarticulation. Whole-context changed-neighbor controls and divided token windows are explicitly limited.

A later uncalibrated or invalid-reference method does not erase earlier valid matched-control evidence. Genuine original jian/zhong contradiction and unresolvable original da were resolved by deleting 之间, TTS-only 忠国, and rewriting 打到 to 来到 respectively.
All raw initial pending and failed/reverse components remain in archived original reports. This is a separate scoped adjudication, not edits changing old pending into pass.
The new deepest sentence reuses close actual old controls only after evaluating the new whole actual waveform; exact old whole-request approval is not inherited.
Neutral le/de checks compare legal voiced rhymes, with actual neutral phone labels recorded; no fixed contour is used as a universal neutral-tone criterion.
The fixed brand request reuses exact prior full text/profile/MP3/WordBoundary; it has no per-word exemption.
Final encoded film timing, source sound, music and WeChat delivery are outside this voice report.
